what: Known limited, collector's, premium and steelbook PS2 editions of games, for the game page. ebay_prices.py looks each one up once a day, the PAL list on eBay UK and the US list on eBay US, by the game's name plus the words in require, so a plain copy is never counted. Numbers only are kept, in data/prices/latest.json under editions.
method: Hand-made from the Collectors Edition game database (collectorsedition.org/game-db, the PS2 PAL and NTSC lists, 14 and 23 entries; the pages were read one by one on 2026-10-14). 32 of those 37 entries are here. Left out: Dragon Ball Z Budokai 3 Collector's Edition (PAL), Silent Hill 2 Special 2 Disc Set (PAL) and Bully Special Edition (NTSC), whose pages did not load that day; Final Fantasy XI HDD (not a game edition); and one entry not read. Contents are quoted from each entry, packaging in kinds. Japanese editions cannot be priced (only the US and UK sites are), so none are here. Nothing was sent to the database's owners (rule 13).
